title: Lore of Lockheed and Northrop crash retrievals without oversight

tellings.quote: the UFO front, you have all this lore of like the Lockheeds and Northreps engaging in crash retrievalss and not having proper supervision or oversight when it comes to the government.

plain: Michels says there is a whole body of UFO lore holding that the defence companies Lockheed and Northrop have recovered crashed craft of unknown origin, which the field calls crash retrievals, without proper government supervision or oversight. He describes it himself as lore, without naming a source, in an episode with a former NSA director. If true, it would mean private companies hold such material beyond the government's control.
